styles.treatment: Flat 2D explanatory line-and-fill illustration, graded ink outlines and fine structural detail. Restrained primary, primarySoft and neutral flat color regions, with minimal graphic tonal accents only to explain structure. Human heads and clothing stay flat. No spherical gradients, inflated volume, plastic shine, bevels, extrusion, ambient occlusion or cast shadows. More object structure than a generic pictogram, never a 3D material render. For compact report icons use one dominant object and at most one supporting cue, broad flat fills and few structural lines. Do not turn a technical topic into a miniature device assembly; avoid circuit/port/fin microdetail at small size.

styles.treatment: Credible realistic physical objects of the current brief's physical objects. Real material joins, functional construction and restrained studio lighting. For abstract ideas, choose and record a meaningful physical-object metaphor rather than sculpting an arbitrary glyph. Preserve the current meaning; no decorative floor plate, display base or brand; include a setting only when requested.
avoidCases: Abstract meanings requiring many literal props

styles.treatment: Mature approachable adult figures and credible objects with purposeful business actions. Elegant graded dark-ink contours, fine selected structural detail, restrained flat color regions, soft tonal modeling and subtle watercolor surface texture. Bright spacious compositions. Preserve this same ink-and-watercolor drawing method in illustrations and icons; small icons reduce detail but do not switch to flat Technical Spot, glossy 3D or a different renderer. No childish proportions, exaggerated limbs or generic office clipart. Paper texture belongs to the depicted artwork, not an opaque canvas.

policy.lifecycle: Change or retire one shared style for both asset kinds. Retired IDs, names and legacy numbers are reserved and fail explicitly without automatic replacement.
policy.adaptation: Scale detail and composition to the asset; preserve the exact drawing method, contour, fill, material, texture and lighting. Do not substitute a related style.
policy.numbering: Never reassign a published legacy number or ID. displayOrder is presentation order only and is not a numeric selector.
